prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
One square full-character concept image for a Danish learning platform, a distinct original whale mascot who teaches how to deploy software with Docker containers. Show an unmistakable whale with flippers, broad horizontal tail flukes and no human legs. Visually connect shipping containers to software deployment through equipment with progress or health indicators. Prioritize one memorable character, a strong facial expression and silhouette, and enough margin for flukes and props. A simple warm off-white studio background with subtle grounding where needed; no frame or caption. Original character design, no logos or imitation of Docker's whale mark.
A big, gentle slate-blue humpback whale with authentic ridged ivory throat, long ivory-edged flippers and a broad curled-up tail, tawny eyes, soft weathered smile. Thick navy fisherman sweater, tiny mustard knit cap that leaves the blowhole clear, and a sea-glass bead on a practical pocket radio. Checks a green deployment light on a tiny container barge floating beside him; small cable connects the container's ribs to a terminal. He keeps an absurdly tidy logbook of tide times. Tactile hand-painted gouache and pencil, warm Nordic picture-book illustration, rich soft brush marks and paper grain, grounded dark navy and ochre, understated side lighting. Full mascot shown in profile three-quarter, dominating the image, with the tiny barge as scale contrast.
